name: Quotes
description: A clean, full-screen quotation for any display. Each load shows one school-friendly quote, set in a large serif over a warm ink ground. Schools can add their own quotes from a Google Sheet.
summary: A fresh quote for any display.

sheet.title: Our own quotes (Google Sheet)
sheet.description: Optional. The Quotes tab’s Publish to web link (CSV), with columns Show, Quote, Author. Mixed with the built-in set, one of yours is shown about half the time.

ours.title: Only our own quotes
ours.description: Leave off to mix your sheet with the built-in set.
